CRUMB HOUSE BAKERY
Website Brief

Prepared by: Hina Raza (hina.personal@gmail.com)
Date: 3 November 2026

1. Background

Crumb House is a family bakery in Lahore that has baked sourdough, croissants and celebration cakes since 2014. We sell from one shop in Gulberg and want a website so people can see the menu, check our hours and order custom cakes on WhatsApp.

2. Target Audience

Families and office teams in Gulberg and DHA who want fresh bread and
cakes made the same morning.

3. Menu

• Sourdough loaf – Rs 650
• Butter croissant – Rs 280
• Celebration cakes – from Rs 4,500. Made to order, two days notice
• Coffee and tea - Rs 350
• Catering boxes: Breakfast for offices, minimum ten people

4. Website Goals

The site should make people message us on WhatsApp to order.
We want 200 online orders a month by March.

5. Pages

- Home
- Menu
- Our story
- Custom cakes
- Contact

6. Design Direction

Warm, friendly and inviting. Cosy colours, nothing corporate.

7. What customers say

"Best sourdough in Lahore, by a mile." - Ayesha R., Gulberg
"They made my daughter's cake exactly as she drew it." - Bilal K.

8. Contact

Address: 14 Main Boulevard, Gulberg III, Lahore
Phone: +92 42 3555 0142
WhatsApp: +92 300 555 0142
Opening hours: Mon to Sat 7am to 9pm; Sun 8am to 2pm
instagram.com/crumbhouse.lhr

9. Timeline

Launch before 1 December.
